summary: 拥有电影制作专业背景的视觉创作者，擅长摄影、短片导演及 AI 辅助创作。致力于用影像语言讲述具有人文深度的故事。
summaryEn: A visual creator with a background in film production, specializing in photography, short film directing, and AI-assisted creation. Dedicated to telling stories with humanistic depth through visual language.

experience.description: 参与多部商业短片及纪录片的拍摄制作，负责摄影、灯光及后期调色。独立完成 3 个商业项目的摄影指导工作。
experience.descriptionEn: Participated in the production of multiple commercial short films and documentaries. Served as Director of Photography for 3 commercial projects.
highlights: 完成 3 个商业项目的摄影指导
建立标准化后期工作流程

experience.description: 以自由职业者身份承接摄影及短视频制作项目。期间探索 AI 工具在创作流程中的应用。
experience.descriptionEn: Worked as a freelance photographer and video creator. Explored AI tools in creative workflows during this period.
highlights: 建立 AI 辅助创作工作流
